## Fixed

- **NeoForge: crash when another mod handles Liquid XP or Milk.** Hydrofarm's fluids were missing a
  piece of NeoForge-specific registration (a `FluidType`), so any other mod that so much as looked
  at them threw an error. The worst case was a backpack that had pumped Liquid XP into its own
  tank: the crash then fired every time the backpack was drawn — including the moment you joined
  the world — which locked you out of that save permanently.
  **Already stuck? This update fixes it by itself.** Load the world with this version and it will
  open normally, with the Liquid XP still in the backpack. Nothing to edit, nothing to delete.

- **NeoForge: machines could not exchange items with pipes or hoppers, and inserted items were
  destroyed.** The Autocrafter, Mending Station, Hydroponics Bed, Tree Farm Bed, Husbandry Bed and
  Butcher Bed all exposed a stale copy of their inventory instead of the real one. In practice:
  the Autocrafter's result could not be pulled out, beds never noticed food delivered by pipes,
  harvested produce could not be pumped away — and, most seriously, **items pushed into any of
  these blocks by a pipe or another mod's automation were silently deleted.** All of these now use
  a live view of the real inventory.
  This affected NeoForge only, in every version of the mod to date. Fabric was never affected.

- **NeoForge: Liquid XP and Milk showed as a magenta "missing texture" block** in other mods'
  tanks and in Jade/JEI. They now use their proper textures, matching Fabric.

## Notes

- Fabric behaviour is unchanged by this release.
- If you play on NeoForge and have Hydrofarm machines wired into item automation, it is worth
  re-checking those setups after updating — anything that appeared to do nothing before should
  now work, and pipes that were quietly eating items will stop.
- Same fixes as v0.3.6 on the Minecraft 26.2 line.
